text: There is **insufficient evidence** to determine the tree-cover change status for this rural property (ASSET-K). No observations were made due to **missing data coverage**—none of the required Earth-observation sources (Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020, or MGAP 2021) were available for analysis. This means we cannot confirm whether tree-cover loss occurred within the asset after the 2020 baseline. The assessment remains inconclusive.
